## What does this change?

<!-- One or two sentences. Which skill(s), and what behaviour changes for the person running it. -->

Closes #<!-- issue number (required for new skills and breaking changes) -->

## Change type

- [ ] Patch — wording, typo, snippet bug, broken link
- [ ] Minor — new capability that doesn't change existing behaviour
- [ ] Breaking — renamed/removed config, changed report layout or verdict rules
- [ ] New skill

## How was it tested?

<!-- Which agent (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), which demo app, which inputs.
     Link or attach a sanitised sample output. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tested against a real application with an AI agent
- [ ] Ran it twice on the same input — step count, verdict and output structure were identical
- [ ] Tried a failing case and a missing-input case; both ended in the documented outcome
- [ ] Every script or snippet I added or changed has actually been executed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for every skill touched
- [ ] README catalog / flow diagram updated (if a skill was added or its purpose changed)
- [ ] Section cross-references (`§N.N`) still point to the right place
- [ ] **Sanitised:** no secrets, company names, internal URLs, private ticket IDs, personal data or local paths — including in screenshots
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this under the MIT License
